items.title: Mayor Bensouda Says Gambians Have Right to Protest at State House Without Police Permit
items.summary: By Fatou Sillah Talib Ahmed Bensouda, leader of the UNITE and presidential candidate for Coalition 2026, has asserted that Gambians have a constitutional right to stage peaceful protests outside State House without obtaining a police permit. Speaking at a Coalition 2026 rally ...
items.author: Fatou Sillah
